g.text: Question: With four requests contributing 2,048 tokens each, what happens as more have long histories?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Every point is 4 × 2,048 = 8,192 useful tokens. Early requests start at 0; late requests start at 253,952. Every request's end index is its

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Result: Both methods slow down as more requests have long histories. Ragged remains slower. Its extra time is 29%, 18%, 13%, 9%, 7% as the
